warning: issuer_private_key_seed_hex below is a fixed, non-secret, deliberately unmysterious test seed (bytes(range(32))). NEVER use it for anything but verifying an implementation against these vectors.

vectors.name: minimal_valid
vectors.description: Minimal token: one exact capability, empty constraints. 'valid' here means correct signature/schema/canonicalization -- iat/exp are fixed for byte-reproducibility, so check TTL/expiry math against these values yourself rather than expecting a live verify() call to accept this token as currently fresh.

vectors.name: full_constraints_and_wildcard
vectors.description: Wildcard capability, all four constraint fields populated, exp-iat at the 30s ceiling exactly. Same freshness caveat as minimal_valid: iat/exp are fixed, not currently fresh.

vectors.name: ttl_exceeds_max
vectors.description: exp - iat = 31 > MAX_TTL_SECONDS (30). Rejected on this ground alone, independent of wall-clock time, so this vector never goes stale.

vectors.name: tampered_signature
vectors.description: Valid header/payload, signature's first base64url character flipped.

vectors.name: kid_does_not_match_signing_key
vectors.description: Signed by the trusted issuer key, but header.kid is a different public key. Verifiers must check kid against the key that verifies, not ignore it.

vectors.name: delegable_token_not_directly_usable
vectors.description: A token with dlg set and no prf is an invitation to attenuate, not a credential a tool may accept.

vectors.name: attenuated_delegation
vectors.description: One hop. The parent names agent:worker-02 and cannot be used directly. The child narrows tool:* to tool:process_payout and tightens both limits. Verify with a registry: root key for agent:requester-01, holder key for agent:worker-02. Pin the clock to claims.iat + 10. A holder key must not be accepted as a root issuer.

vectors.name: delegation_capability_widened
vectors.description: Child capability other:admin is outside the parent grant tool:*. Attenuation must fail.

temporal_test_cases.name: ttl_ceiling_exact_30_is_ok
temporal_test_cases.reason: exp - iat == 30 (MAX_TTL_SECONDS), the ceiling itself, not over it.

temporal_test_cases.name: ttl_ceiling_31_rejected
temporal_test_cases.reason: exp - iat == 31 > MAX_TTL_SECONDS. Checked before, and independent of, now.

temporal_test_cases.name: not_yet_valid_leeway_boundary_ok
temporal_test_cases.reason: now (998) == iat (1000) - leeway (2), the boundary itself is accepted.

temporal_test_cases.name: expired_leeway_boundary_ok
temporal_test_cases.reason: now (1032) == exp (1030) + leeway (2), the boundary itself is accepted.
